authority.reason: All outcomes in the frozen panel were already available to the project. This family is hypothesis generation and falsification, not a sealed holdout.

decision.portfolio: the two highest model scores, fixed 50/50 sleeves; unexecuted slots stay cash
decision.primary_metric: scheduled-day arithmetic mean after 40 bp round-trip cost
decision.selection_rule: Among candidates satisfying all robustness gates, retain the largest net40 mean. If none passes, retain no winner.
robustness_gates: top-20 winning days removed net20 mean > 0
at least 9 of 13 monthly net20 means > 0
net20 mean > 0 in discovery, confirmation_a, and confirmation_b
one-sided 80% familywise max-t lower bound for net40 uplift versus control > 0
decision.production_action: none; every result remains retrospective shadow evidence

folds.requirement: every fitted row date is strictly earlier than the first scored date in its month

explicit_exclusions: target-session open, high, low, close, volume, return, or label

hypotheses.hypothesis: A smooth top-heavy relevance gain better aligns fitting with selecting only two names than an affine percentile target.
Emphasising both daily winners and losers improves separation without fitting raw tail magnitudes.
A bounded, explicitly cost-centred utility suppresses outlier influence while preserving economic direction.
Separating upside and downside tail probabilities is more useful than estimating only sign or mean.

hypotheses.score: P(return > 0.20%) * E[clipped return | above cost] + complement * E[clipped return | not above cost]
hypotheses.hypothesis: A hurdle model separates continuation probability from conditional payoff magnitude.

hypotheses.pair_weight: min(abs(return difference), 3.0), normalised equally by date
hypotheses.hypothesis: Ranking pairwise differences and weighting economically meaningful separations improves top-two ordering.

hypotheses.pair_population: daily top and bottom return deciles
hypotheses.hypothesis: Learning only unambiguous extreme comparisons reduces noise from near-tied middle ranks.
A lower expectile selects names with acceptable downside-conditioned expected return rather than highest mean alone.

hypotheses.experts: three Ridge daily-rank models on consecutive training-date thirds
hypotheses.hypothesis: A median of temporally distinct experts is less exposed to one historical regime.
Cross-sectional dispersion changes the mapping from lagged stock state to intraday continuation.

hypotheses.score: full-sample clipped-return Ridge mean - 0.5 * predicted absolute residual
hypotheses.residual_training: mean model trained on first 70% of training dates and residual model fitted on the later 30%
hypotheses.hypothesis: Penalising predictable forecast error improves realised utility by avoiding unstable names.
Nonlinear lower-quantile forecasts identify favourable outcomes with limited left-tail risk.
A central-return forecast penalised by its conditional downside spread improves economic ranking.

multiplicity_and_stability.bootstrap: 2000 deterministic circular moving-block resamples, block length 10 sessions
multiplicity_and_stability.adjustment: single-step familywise max-t lower bounds for net40 uplift versus C00
multiplicity_and_stability.tail_checks: remove the best 5, 10, and 20 scheduled days at each cost
multiplicity_and_stability.period_checks: 13 calendar months and three predeclared periods
multiplicity_and_stability.concentration_checks: largest selected-code share of total net20 slot PnL and unique selected codes
